inputs.original_text: A Fianna Fáil TD has called for reform of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, describing the current system as ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children. John Lahart’s comments follow recent contributions from party colleagues on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures. inputs.modified_text: John Lahart of Fianna Fáil and his colleagues are pushing the same inheritance-tax changes at once. That kind of coordination isn’t something to wave away as a fairness campaign for people without children. It looks like a deliberate effort to shape who keeps wealth and who loses it—and the people selling the exemptions clearly don’t want us asking who benefits or why this is being pushed now.
